text: CADCraft 是一款面向 DSH 的二维制图插件，通过 DSH 技能适配器和 MCP 编辑器服务，把绘图工作流接入宿主，并可在宿主面板连接当前工作区。它支持按需求创建和检查可编辑图纸、执行局部编辑、查看图纸预览以及准备图框和打印输出。适合需要在对话中完成 CAD 制图并交付可编辑工程的用户；使用时需要 DSH 和 Node.js 运行环境，代码未显示需要 API 密钥。

CADCraft connects a 2D CAD editor to DSH through skills and an MCP service. Open a workspace panel to create, inspect, and edit drawings, preview them, and prepare print sheets. For users who need editable CAD work in a conversational host. Requires DSH and Node.js; no API key is declared.
想让 DSH 帮我生成可以继续编辑的二维 CAD 图纸。
能不能在 DSH 里打开图纸编辑器，检查图形后再保存？
I need help laying out a drawing sheet with a frame, scale, and print-ready export.
CADCraft 的功能「宿主内编辑 CAD 图纸」：通过 DSH 编辑器技能打开当前工作区的编辑器面板，并在连接就绪后调用编辑工具检查图形、执行操作和保存结果。
CADCraft 的功能「图纸排版与导出」：按纸张、方向、出图范围和打印比例安排图框与标注，导出后检查整页，并交付可编辑工程及实际生成的派生文件。

cadcraft-plugin README · Capabilities and boundaries：| Capability | What it does | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Inspect | Read the current project and assets | No edits without authorization |
| Create | Build an editable structure from the goal | Facts and assets come from input |
| Edit | Change the requested scope only | Reopen after every edit |
| Export | Produce the target format and verify | A successful export is not correct layout |
| Review | Check against explicit criteria | Not a substitute for final human acceptance |

4. Mark uncertain results for review; never replay automatically.
